chars.SON: a Moroccan man around 28, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman around 22, simple and naive look, wearing a lilac long djellaba with a white headscarf, carrying a small beige handbag
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother around 58, plump, wearing a dark green house kaftan with a black headscarf and small gold earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Early morning in a modern Moroccan apartment entrance hall. WIFE is caught mid-act quietly opening the front door to slip out, glancing back over her shoulder with a guilty little smile, seen from the far end of the hallway as a witness would see her. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm morning light, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with low sofas and patterned cushions. MOM leans toward SON and whispers a warning with a raised finger, eyebrows raised, SON listens surprised holding a tea glass. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Noon sun on a narrow Moroccan neighborhood street with a small corner grocery shop behind. WIFE walks back home late carrying only one tiny plastic bag with a loaf of bread, looking relaxed and dreamy. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SON sits alone on the edge of a Moroccan salon sofa at night, elbows on knees, frowning and worried, rubbing his beard, thinking hard. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, soft lamp light, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SON peeks suspiciously from a kitchen doorway at WIFE, who stands at the kitchen counter smiling innocently while stirring a tajine, unaware. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, Moroccan tiled kitchen, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan bedroom. SON stands with hands open, talking seriously to WIFE who sits on the bed edge looking down at her hands, a bit sulky. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE strolls slowly through a lively Moroccan neighborhood alley, curiously looking up at houses and at neighbors chatting on doorsteps, in no hurry at all. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, afternoon light, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room. SON gestures around the room suggesting she find something to do at home, pointing at a sewing machine and some books on a table, WIFE listens with crossed arms, unconvinced. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: WIFE jumps up from the sofa with sudden excitement, hands clasped, eyes sparkling, begging SON for a smartphone, SON surprised leaning back. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, Moroccan living room, 2D animated illustration, no text.
